name: rules-diplomacy-ready-cap
description: Rules audit (deliberate improvement over the original): Diplomacy readies 'up to 2 exhausted planets'. The original readied every planet pressed on the ready prompt. Muaat (pbd72 r4, all planets exhausted first) plays Diplomacy, picks a system, opens Ready Planets and readies 2 planets; the 3rd refresh_ must be refused (engine: PlanetReadyKind.validate; bot: PlanetExhaustButtonHandler.refresh) and that planet stays exhausted.
